clue.text: Cautious about boy becoming cleaner

indicators.note: about means going around, so the cautious word wraps the boy

parts.note: chary means wary or cautious
a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: A careful parent frets over a son taking up domestic work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cautious' looks like part of the definition of a careful person, but it is only fodder; 'cleaner' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A charlady is a woman employed to clean houses or offices, so a cleaner by trade.

clue.text: Punch to the face friend pulled up short

indicators.note: pulled up short means stopped before the end, so the last letter is cut

parts.note: china is cockney rhyming slang for mate (china plate), a friend

explanation.surface: A friend reins in a blow to someone's face.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Punch to the face' is a verb phrase here, to hit on the jaw. CHINA from china plate is London rhyming slang for mate.
explanation.definitionFit: To chin someone is slang for punching them on the jaw.

clue.text: Cases of people laying down their own lives for others

definitions.text: Cases of people laying down their own lives for others

parts.words: Cases of people laying down their own lives for others
parts.note: looks like self-sacrifice, but laying down means setting on paper a life story for others to read

explanation.definitionFit: Books in which writers record their own life stories for readers.

clue.text: Salvages fragments in city surrounded by desert

indicators.note: fragments means breaks into pieces, so the word salvages is broken up and rebuilt

explanation.surface: A scavenger rescues scraps in a desert city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fragments' is a verb, rearranging SALVAGES; 'in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: The Nevada gambling city stands in the Mojave Desert.

clue.text: Actor originally following spirit of the Scottish play

indicators.note: following means coming after, so the actor's letter comes after the spirit

parts.note: a dram is a measure of spirit, especially whisky

indicators.note: originally asks for the opening letter of the word actor

explanation.surface: An actor first takes a whisky before Macbeth.
explanation.walkthrough: Theatre folk call Macbeth 'the Scottish play' to avoid naming it; it is a stage play.
explanation.definitionFit: Macbeth is a stage tragedy, an example of drama.

clue.text: Group of bones found in ancient Turkish city

definitions.meaning: the set of small bones of the ankle and upper foot
the city in Cilicia, now southern Turkey, birthplace of St Paul

explanation.surface: An archaeologist turns up a pile of bones at an old site in Turkey.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the ankle-bone cluster in anatomy and an old city of Asia Minor.

clue.text: In which a beautiful female gets absorbed?

definitions.text: In which a beautiful female gets absorbed?

indicators.note: gets absorbed means is taken in, so the female letter goes inside

parts.note: fair means beautiful

explanation.surface: A question about something a lovely woman becomes engrossed in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets absorbed' places F inside A FAIR, after the A. Read whole, the clue describes a romance that a beautiful woman becomes caught up in.
explanation.definitionFit: A love affair is something a person becomes engrossed and involved in.

clue.text: Plant not growing is a wallflower

parts.note: shrinking means getting smaller, not growing
the violet is a flowering plant

explanation.surface: A stunted plant is said to be a wallflower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wallflower' looks like another plant but means a shy person at a party.
explanation.definitionFit: A wallflower is a shy person left out at dances, as is a timid, retiring person.

clue.text: Esprit de corps I'd seen in royalist organisation

indicators.note: seen in places the first piece inside the second
organisation means arrangement, so the letters of royalist are reorganised

parts.note: taken as written, I and D

explanation.surface: A team spirit is noticed within a monarchist society.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organisation' looks like the noun for a body such as a club, but it signals rearrangement, giving SOLARITY.
explanation.definitionFit: Esprit de corps is shared loyalty and fellowship within a group, the unity of purpose behind solidarity.

clue.text: Medical group seen flying across the country on April 23rd

definitions.meaning: the international humanitarian and medical relief organisation

definitions.text: seen flying across the country on April 23rd
definitions.meaning: St George's flag, a ... on white, is flown across England on St George's Day

explanation.surface: A medical team's flag flies across England on St George's Day.
explanation.walkthrough: April 23rd is St George's Day, when England flies his flag, a red cross on white.
explanation.definitionFit: The aid organisation's emblem and England's St George flag both show a red cross.

clue.text: Not having planned to leave in midwinter, say

parts.note: the middle of the word winter, all but its first and last letters
to say is to state

explanation.surface: Someone decides not to go away during the depths of winter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link word. 'Planned to leave' means made a will, not a travel plan.
explanation.definitionFit: Dying intestate means dying without a will, never having arranged what to bequeath.

clue.text: Heads off if her pal becomes wild

indicators.note: the first letter of each of the three words is cut away, as heads lopped off

explanation.surface: A friend of hers goes off the rails, losing their head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heads off' removes I, H and P from IF HER PAL, leaving F + ER + AL.
explanation.definitionFit: Feral animals have gone wild after domestication, so feral is a synonym for wild.

clue.text: Old Bank of England, originally, as issuer of notes

indicators.note: originally points to the opening letter of each of the four words

explanation.surface: The Bank of England of old is described as the body that printed banknotes.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface wants banknotes; the notes are musical ones, played by a woodwind instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A woodwind instrument produces musical notes, so it fits a playful issuer of notes.

clue.text: Dealt with lots of special education

indicators.note: special suggests a specially rearranged version of the word education

explanation.surface: A school deals with many pupils in special education.
explanation.walkthrough: 'special' reshuffles EDUCATION. 'Lots' are items in a saleroom, not quantities.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods auctioned are disposed of as numbered lots at a sale, so dealt with in lots.

clue.text: Fast food bringing complaint by respectable citizen, say

parts.note: beef is slang for a grievance or complaint

indicators.note: say signals the sound of a word, not its spelling

parts.note: a burgher is a solid citizen of a town

explanation.surface: Junk food prompts a grumble from a worthy townsman.
explanation.definitionFit: A beefburger is a minced-beef patty served in a bun, typical fast food.

clue.text: A worrier about business, possibly

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters could be arranged another way

parts.note: CO is short for company, a business

explanation.surface: Someone anxious about commerce, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' shuffles A WORRIER with CO; 'about' is a link word. Read whole, the clue also describes an environmental activist fretting over corporate behaviour.
explanation.definitionFit: An environmental campaigner worries about what businesses do to the planet, so the whole clue describes one.

clue.text: Trust priest in organfsed religion

annotationWithheld.why: Trust priest in organised religion (8): RELIANCE; ELI (priest) fits inside, but no reading of 'organised religion' gives the remaining R, A, N, C, E, so a word appears misread or the parse is missing

clue.text: Secure to river bank

parts.note: to tie something is to secure it
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: Someone moors a boat to the riverbank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bank' looks like a riverside but means a row, as in a bank of seats.
explanation.definitionFit: A bank of seats or switches is one row in a series, which is what a tier is.

clue.text: Benediction bishop bestowed on playwright

indicators.note: in a down clue, bestowed on means placed on top of, so the bishop comes first

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
Gotthold Lessing was a German dramatist

explanation.surface: A bishop gives his blessing to a dramatist.
explanation.definitionFit: A benediction is a spoken prayer invoking divine favour, a synonym of blessing.

clue.text: Threaten bishops with queen, say, instead of king

parts.note: for can mean in place of, as in swapping one thing for another
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A chess player menaces two bishops using a piece other than the king.
explanation.walkthrough: In chess one piece attacking two at once (here a queen hitting both bishops) is a fork.
explanation.definitionFit: A chess fork is a single piece attacking two enemy pieces at once.

clue.text: Escape without corporal punishment —- that's illuminating

indicators.note: without here means outside, so the escape word goes around the punishment

parts.note: flight is escape, as in taking flight
the lash is a whipping, a form of corporal punishment

explanation.surface: A fugitive avoids a beating, which is an enlightening outcome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking' but is the old sense 'outside'.
explanation.definitionFit: A torch or flashlight is a device that lights things up, something that is illuminating.

clue.text: Where axes cut old equipment at home

parts.note: a rig is a set of equipment
in means at home

explanation.surface: Old tools are kept at home, where the axes do their chopping.
explanation.walkthrough: 'axes' looks like choppers but are graph axes, plural of axis.
explanation.definitionFit: On a graph, the origin is the point where the x and y axes intersect.

clue.text: Control that's not usually right for driver

definitions.meaning: having the advantage or dominance over others

definitions.text: that's not usually right for driver
definitions.meaning: on a golf driver the hand gripping higher up the club is normally the left one, for right-handed players

explanation.surface: Steering the car is something seldom done from the right-hand side.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a motorist; the driver is a golf club, gripped with the left hand on top by most players.
explanation.definitionFit: To have the advantage in a contest is to hold control, a common idiom.

clue.text: Rule out book with expensive cover

indicators.note: cover means wrap around, so the expensive word encloses the book

parts.note: dear means costly

explanation.surface: A ban on a book with a pricey binding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cover' is a verb: DEAR wraps around B; 'with' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: To debar someone is to exclude or prohibit them, ruling them out.

clue.text: Hide son pursued by relatives.

indicators.note: pursued by means followed by, so the son comes first

parts.note: S is the genealogy abbreviation for son
kin are one's relatives

explanation.surface: A boy goes into hiding while family members chase him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hide' looks like a verb but is the noun, an animal's pelt.
explanation.definitionFit: An animal's hide is its skin, the two being synonyms.

clue.text: Postpone visit

definitions.meaning: a period of ... somewhere as a guest

explanation.surface: Put off a trip.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both suspending a legal process and a temporary sojourn somewhere.

clue.text: Condition, of course, repeated as sale nears completion

definitions.meaning: the state of the ground on a racecourse, such as good or soft
the auctioneer's twice-called warning before the hammer falls

explanation.surface: An auctioneer, reaching the end of a sale, repeats the terms.
explanation.definitionFit: Racing reports describe turf state with this term, and auctioneers call it twice before saying gone.

clue.text: Accountant with vivacity allowed in carriage

parts.note: CA stands for chartered accountant
brio is vigour or vivacity
let means allowed

explanation.surface: A lively accountant is permitted to ride in a coach.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabriolet is a light two-wheeled horse-drawn carriage with a folding hood.

clue.text: Upwardly mobile, and so revolting

explanation.surface: A social climber is also thoroughly disgusting.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both ascending and an insurrection, so it covers both senses.

clue.text: Bowled with accuracy and with intelligence

parts.note: B is the cricket abbreviation for bowled
rightly means correctly, with accuracy

explanation.surface: A cricketer bowls accurately and cleverly.
explanation.definitionFit: Bright means clever, so acting brightly is acting with intelligence.
